Title: Azure Arc enabled servers are now generally available

Body.Content:
You can now manage and govern Windows and Linux servers from a single pane of glass, whether they are on-premises or in other clouds. Control plane functionality includes:

  • Resource organization through Azure management groups and tagging
  • Searching and indexing through Azure Resource Graph
  • Access and security through RBAC and subscriptions
  • Environments and automation through templates and extensions

In addition, you can leverage native Azure services to optimize management overhead and modernize operations like Azure Monitor, Azure Defender, Azure Update Management, Azure Policy and more.
